author: Yffe
content: Failing test at thermite-spec/tests/divergence_spec.rs::divergence_unknown_method_call_in_contract_is_rejected (run with --include-ignored). 'req xs.frobnicate()' validates clean (Ok(())). Root cause: validator.rs walk_expr_inner Expr::MethodCall arm accepts ANY method name structurally, only recursing into receiver+args; it never checks the method name against the bounded built-in set. The oracle accept fixtures only exercise xs.len(), so this cage leak is invisible to existing fixtures (over-fitting). Authority: .design/spec/spectherm-combinators.md REQ-3(c) ('the bounded built-in MethodCalls the grammar admits, e.g. xs.len()') + REQ-4(iv) (forbidden parsed construct -> ForbiddenCall); thermite-design.md §4.2 (locks the cage).
